description: Convert an instant to wall-clock time in a named IANA time zone, or a wall-clock time in a zone back to an instant. Returns the local date and time, the UTC offset in ±HH:MM and seconds, the zone abbreviation, whether DST is in effect, the ISO week date, and the day of year. Handles the ambiguous and skipped local times at DST boundaries explicitly rather than guessing. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

ambiguous.description: Only with local: which instant a repeated local time maps to. Default earlier. Accepted: earlier, later, reject.

instant.description: RFC 3339 timestamp or integer Unix seconds/milliseconds. Defaults to now. Mutually exclusive with local. Accepted: RFC 3339 timestamp or integer epoch.

local.description: Wall-clock time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS] in zone, converted back to an instant. Mutually exclusive with instant. Accepted: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS].

zone.description: IANA time zone id, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam. Accepted: an IANA time zone id, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam.

name: time_zone
title: Instant to wall-clock time in an IANA zone, with offset and DST state
